anomalies.description: The scene depicts a violent street confrontation involving multiple uniformed officers and at least one civilian on the ground, with debris scattered, wet pavement suggesting recent unrest, and presence of riot gear—indicative of collective violent unrest.
Multiple police officers in riot gear are restraining a person lying on the ground, applying force while the individual appears incapacitated and unable to resist.

Multiple uniformed officers in riot gear surround and physically restrain a seated, injured individual wearing a yellow vest and gas mask; the individual appears helpless and is being handled aggressively, with visible facial injury and no resistance observed.

Multiple officers in riot gear are physically restraining a person wearing a high-visibility vest and a gas mask; the individual appears subdued and is being held down or lifted by several officers, with no visible resistance, indicating a helpless victim being subjected to force.

A group of riot police officers in full protective gear are actively advancing through a street filled with smoke/tear gas and wet ground, carrying a restrained individual while other individuals (some appearing to be protesters) are visible in the background; this constitutes collective violent unrest involving police and civilians.

In the background at 11.0–11.5s, multiple officers in riot gear are engaged in coordinated physical action amid smoke and wet streets, consistent with active crowd control during violent unrest; a red vehicle (possibly fire truck) and distant figures suggest broader chaotic context.

Three riot police officers in full protective gear (helmets, shields, body armor) are seen moving rapidly across a wet street while carrying or dragging a person between them; smoke and other protesters are visible in the background, indicating an active protest or clash.; A car is fully engulfed in flames on its side on the street, emitting thick black smoke; two riot police officers stand nearby observing, with a building and storefront visible in the background — consistent with arson during civil unrest.

Sudden burst of white smoke/cloud at street level near traffic lights and barriers, consistent with a canister discharge (e.g., tear gas or stun grenade), visible in frames f0–f1 as rapidly expanding plume with no preceding fire or impact.

Sustained violent unrest with deployment of tear gas or smoke canisters, barricades, and presence of individuals in yellow vests amidst debris and smoke on a city street; police vehicle present near damaged infrastructure.

Second sudden smoke burst near ground level in front of traffic signal pole, distinct from earlier plume, occurring in frame f14–f15; appears as localized rapid expansion of white smoke, indicative of another canister detonation.

Police officers in riot gear are deployed on a street while a high-pressure water cannon sprays a large cloud of water mist across the road, indicating active crowd control during unrest.; A damaged police van with shattered windshield and dented front is parked on a street; background shows individuals in yellow vests and other police, consistent with ongoing civil unrest.

A large fire burns in the street, likely from an intentionally set barricade or vehicle, with heavy smoke and visible police riot control presence (armored vehicle, officers with shields) indicating collective violent unrest.; A fire burns in a narrow street, producing thick smoke; two uniformed officers with riot shields stand near the blaze while a water cannon truck is positioned nearby, indicating an active riot control operation.
Two individuals wearing yellow vests are seen in a smoky environment; one appears to be picking up or throwing an object, consistent with riot activity.

Multiple individuals in yellow vests walk through a dense haze of what appears to be tear gas or smoke in an urban street setting, with debris on the ground and tense posture suggesting ongoing unrest.; Wide shot shows a wet public square littered with debris (including a tire), with police water cannon vehicles and scattered individuals in yellow vests and dark uniforms; scene consistent with aftermath or lull in a riot.
